=== twaco mashup why Acme.Case_MU toolbar
Acme.Case_MU flexcontainer-3 (flexcontainer, toolbar)
  slot "toolbar" of template tab-content; rules: legacy
  surface               #F7F7F7             rule surface.toolbar-band (rule table)
    now: background=#F7F7F7 [agrees]
  size                  fixed 48px          rule size.toolbar-48 (rule table)
    now: flex-size=fixed, flex-min-height=48px, flex-max-height=48px [agrees]
  gutter                none                rule gutter.tab-content-slot (rule table)
    now: Margin=none [agrees]
  align                 center              rule align.bar (rule table)
    now: align-items=center [agrees]
override:
  twaco mashup set Acme.Case_MU flexcontainer-3 --style background=<colour>
  twaco mashup set Acme.Case_MU flexcontainer-3 --prop flex-grow=<n> (any flex-*, Width or Height setting marks the size as authored)
  twaco mashup set Acme.Case_MU flexcontainer-3 --prop Margin="<top right bottom left>"
  twaco mashup set Acme.Case_MU flexcontainer-3 --prop align-items=<flex-start|center|flex-end|stretch>
